vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At the first-write commit, ensureSandboxed() only resolves and prefix-checks the caller-controlled absolutePath, after which checkSyntax() and runPlaywrightTest() interpolate it into strings passed to child_process.exec. Shell metacharacters therefore remain active despite path containment.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -L on both vulnerable sink lines at tag 13.1.0 and git log --all -S on both exact template strings independently identify fae8a8755faf10cb302f3ce72face7efb7d30a2d as their addition from /dev/null. The commit has exactly one parent and creates FileSystemService.mjs.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The immediate parent is 5e6a184441af4a599f7bc5d63156c7eaa80113dd. Its tree has no ai/mcp/server/file-system path, and targeted grep finds none of checkSyntax, runPlaywrightTest, node --check, or npx playwright test under ai/mcp/server.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC is a single-parent feature commit, and #9750 resolves to a GitHub issue while /pulls/9750 returns 404, so there is no public PR member series to decompose. The later single-parent v13.0.0 aggregate 0045c828f038d3eb427268cceb6116a9b410aa56 copies the already-vulnerable sinks and is not the BIC; parallel replay 5db53c3b7778ac27dbccf02db1543b6d52b8dd3d has the same FileSystemService blob but is not the tagged/dev first-write lineage.

affected_and_fixed_release_membership.evidence: fae8a8755faf10cb302f3ce72face7efb7d30a2d is an ancestor of tags 13.0.0 and 13.1.0, and both tagged trees retain both execAsync shell interpolations. 498018638e1bb046e2135dcda6993ae802bb15c2 is in neither tag; it is an ancestor of origin/dev, and the clone has no tag newer than 13.1.0. Thus 13.0.0 and 13.1.0 are affected and no fixed release is evidenced.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: Fix parent 83039b3707256d475a717f3b6445f188a50057a1 still contains both execAsync interpolations. Commit 498018638e1bb046e2135dcda6993ae802bb15c2 replaces them with execFileAsync and argv arrays, descends from the BIC, and is in origin/dev. Advisory-cited 5acc564ea1b278bca5fab1f8f397a6ba9b849d75 has the identical resulting FileSystemService blob and stable patch-id on a parallel lineage. Commit 88c77fc408fd1307d6efd5cc088ba44de56d7845 changes containment wording after argv execution already exists, so it is not the direct CWE-78 fix.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object and GitHub commit record identify author and committer tobiu <tobiasuhlig78@gmail.com> / login tobiu, contain only the one-line subject, and contain no AI, bot, generation, or co-author trailer. The #9750 issue's ai label describes the product/workstream and is not a BIC commit marker. AI evidence on the later fix is excluded from BIC attribution.

findings: CVE-2026-18482 is currently PUBLISHED in the CVE.org record; GHSA-cmg9-62q9-xmww has withdrawn_at=null, so FALSE_POSITIVE is not indicated.
